headline_cap: Expected move in 3M EIBOR over the next 5 trading days, all signals combined
read: Short-end pressure is building. A CBUAE liquidity drain and firm US inflation data point to 3M EIBOR rising about 10bp over the next week, and SOFR futures price only a small part of that. The long end moves less, as weaker oil offsets Fed repricing. Aldar's own credit picture improved: Moody's moved its outlook to positive and a peer sukuk priced tight.
read_short: CBUAE liquidity drain and firm US inflation point to 3M EIBOR about 10bp higher over the next week, mostly unpriced. Aldar's credit picture improved after Moody's moved to a positive outlook.

alerts.title: CBUAE drains AED 18bn through its M-Bill auction, the largest since March
alerts.impl: Tighter dirham liquidity tends to lift 3M EIBOR before any policy change, so Aldar's floating bank debt resets higher at the next fixing.
alerts.why: After six comparable drains since 2023, 3M EIBOR rose 5 to 11bp within five trading days (median +7bp).
alerts.cite: CBUAE, Monetary Bills auction results, 30 Sep 2026

alerts.title: Moody's revises Aldar's outlook to positive, citing record sales and lower leverage
alerts.impl: Supports tighter spreads on new Aldar bonds and bank facilities, a helpful backdrop for the AED 6.8bn maturing in 2029.
alerts.why: Names Aldar directly. Past positive outlook changes for GCC real estate issuers tightened spreads 4 to 12bp within a week.
alerts.cite: Moody's, rating action on Aldar Properties PJSC, 30 Sep 2026

alerts.title: US core PCE comes in at 2.9%, above forecast; Fed's Waller sees "no urgency" to cut
alerts.impl: A slower Fed path lifts the 1Y to 5Y part of the curve most, and the dirham peg carries it into CBUAE policy.
alerts.why: Comparable days since 2023 moved the AED 2Y swap up 4 to 9bp over five days. About half of that is already priced.
alerts.cite: BEA, Personal Income and Outlays, Aug 2026; Federal Reserve, Waller speech, 30 Sep 2026
